title: One worker-process start arms the new GPU-free render-recovery loop
evidence:
The loop cannot arm itself. The sidekiq process for this app booted 2026-09-19 13:23, before the new
worker directory existed, so its autoloader cannot resolve Growth::AbandonedRenderWorker -- the journal
shows "NameError: uninitialized constant Growth::AbandonedRenderWorker" on every attempt (its dead-set
entry was cleared by hand). The startup re-arm in config/initializers/sidekiq.rb only runs at process
start.

The ask is exactly one command on the box:

    systemctl --user restart turbo-carnival-sidekiq

(or set approvals.cron_mode: approve in the Hermes config so this cron can run it).

Nothing to build and nothing to decide: the code is committed (5b9c0d9) and spec-verified
(17 examples green). Until it is armed, abandoned-render recovery falls back to the GPU-acquiring tick,
which now no longer loses 30 min per reconcile but still does not run during a long foreign GPU hold.

notes.note: Only a human can do this: the worker-process start is blocked for cron runs by the approval policy. One action arms a loop that turns already-rendered images into posts with no GPU (measured 13h+ of paid-for renders left unposted during a foreign GPU hold).
